bonus_improvement.title: HMAC minimum key length documented + worker contract established
bonus_improvement.description: The addition of 'Each key segment must be at least 32 bytes of cryptographic randomness (i.e. 64 hex chars)... The worker rejects keys shorter than 32 bytes at startup (loud abort)' in the template proactively documents a worker-level constraint that doesn't exist yet. This is good practice — it sets a contract for Task 6's worker startup validation and prevents silently weakened callback signing from a short key. One note: Task 6 must implement this startup check to honor the documented contract; if it doesn't, the comment will be misleading. Flagging for Task 6 reviewer attention.
